content_sections.heading: WBPSC Clerkship Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed the Madhyamik Examination conducted by the West Bengal Board of Secondary Education or an equivalent examination. Applicants must possess elementary knowledge of computer operation. Candidates must have the ability to type on a computer at a speed of 20 words per minute in English or 10 words per minute in Bengali . Candidates must select their English or Bengali typing option while submitting the application. The computer operation and typing ability will be assessed only after candidates qualify in both Part-I and Part-II of the examination. An applicant must be an Indian citizen, either by birth or registration, or another national declared eligible by the Government of India, subject to the required eligibility certificate. Candidates must be able to read, write and speak Bengali. This condition does not apply to candidates whose mother tongue is Nepali. For candidates whose mother tongue is neither Bengali nor Nepali, Bengali knowledge will be tested during the computer operation and typing assessment. Candidates whose performance in the required Bengali knowledge test is assessed as average or poor are liable to have their candidature cancelled.

content_sections.text: For eligible Ex-Servicemen who have completed at least six months of continuous service in the Armed Forces of the Union, the period of service may be deducted from their actual age. The resultant age must satisfy the condition specified in the notification, including the permitted three-year margin.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC Clerkship Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The WBPSC Clerkship selection process includes two successive examinations followed by a test of elementary computer operation and typing ability. Part-I Examination (Objective Type): The first stage of the recruitment examination. Candidates obtaining the qualifying marks, subject to shortlisting by the Commission, will become eligible for Part-II. Part-II Examination (Conventional Written Type): Shortlisted candidates will appear in the written examination on a later date announced by WBPSC. Computer Operation and Typing Test: Candidates qualifying in Part-I and Part-II will be assessed for computer knowledge and the required typing speed. Final Merit List: The merit list will be prepared on the basis of marks secured in Part-I and Part-II, provided candidates have qualified in the computer operation and typing assessment. Selected candidates will also be subject to the required medical fitness examination and verification of antecedents before appointment. WBPSC Clerkship Syllabus 2026 The notification specifies a deduction of 0.25 marks for each incorrect answer in multiple-choice questions. The following qualifying percentages apply to the aggregate marks obtained in Part-I and Part-II taken together. The Commission may further relax qualifying marks if a substantial number of posts reserved for eligible categories remain unfilled. These percentages should not be confused with the final competitive cut-off marks.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC Clerkship Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: The WBPSC Clerkship online application process is available through the official website psc.wb.gov.in . Candidates must submit their forms and complete the applicable fee payment on or before 26 October 2026 at 3:30 PM . Only online applications are accepted. Submission of more than one application by the same candidate is strictly prohibited and such applications are liable to cancellation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for WBPSC Clerkship Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Important: Candidates should not submit multiple applications. WBPSC has also directed applicants to upload the requisite documents during the specified edit window, so applicants must follow the document-upload instructions displayed in their official accounts.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC Clerkship Application Edit Window 2026
content_sections.text: WBPSC has scheduled the application edit window from 28 October to 1 November 2026 . Applicants can log in to their individual accounts and edit certain fields, where permitted by the Commission. The edit option can be used only once during the specified period. Only permitted fields can be modified. Applicants wishing to change their address must first update the address in the Profile section and then use the edit facility. Applicants should check and retain a printout of their application to identify errors. Requisite documents must be uploaded during the edit-window period as instructed by the Commission. No request for further changes will be entertained after the edit window closes.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for WBPSC Clerkship Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the required educational, identity and category documents available while completing the application and subsequent verification process. Madhyamik or equivalent examination certificate. Details of a valid photo identity document, such as a passport, PAN card, voter identity card, driving licence, Madhyamik certificate bearing a photograph or another approved government-issued identity document. Applicable caste/category certificate for SC, ST, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), EWS, PwBD, Meritorious Sportsperson or Ex-Serviceman claims. Relevant certificate supporting any claimed reservation or concession. Certificate regarding limitation in writing, where applicable to PwBD candidates seeking a scribe or compensatory time.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC Clerkship Job Location and Posting Preferences
content_sections.text: Recruitment will be made to eligible posts in the Government of West Bengal's Secretariat Departments, Directorates, District offices and regional offices, including Kolkata. Candidates must indicate their posting preferences in the order requested by the Commission. Recommendations will depend on merit position, category, the preferences exercised and the availability of vacancies. Filling in posting preferences is mandatory.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for the WBPSC Lower Division Assistant / Lower Division Clerk Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is administered by the Public Service Commission, West Bengal (WBPSC) for selecting eligible candidates for lower division assistant and lower division clerk posts in Kolkata and across the state.

faq.question: Q2. When does the online application process start for WBPSC LDA/LDC 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process officially commences on 06-10-2026. Interested candidates can submit their applications through the official website until the designated closing date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for the WBPSC Lower Division Assistant / Lower Division Clerk posts?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the online application form as well as the closing date for fee submission is 26-10-2026. Candidates must complete their submissions before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants must have passed the Madhyamik examination of the West Bengal Board of Secondary Education or its equivalent. Additionally, they need computer operation knowledge and a typing speed of 20 wpm in English or 10 wpm in Bengali.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to the WBPSC LDA/LDC position?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 45 years of age as on 01.01.2024. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories such as SC, ST, OBC, and PwBD as per West Bengal government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure offered for the Lower Division Clerk post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary under Level 6, ranging from Rs. 22,700/- to 58,500/- per month, along with additional allowances like Dearness Allowance (D.A.), Medical Allowance (M.A.), and House Rent Allowance (H.R.A.).

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the WBPSC recruitment examination?
faq.answer: General and OBC category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 110/- plus service charges. However, SC/ST candidates of West Bengal and PwBD candidates with 40% and above disability are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection procedure for WBPSC Lower Division Assistant / LDC?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Part-I Examination (Objective Type), a Part-II Examination (Conventional Type – Written), followed by a test to judge elementary knowledge in computer operation and typing speed.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the direct link to apply online for the WBPSC 2026 notification?
faq.answer: You can find the direct online application link and official notification PDF in the Important Links section of this article, or you can visit the official website at https://psc.wb.gov.in/.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any provision to edit the application form after submission?
faq.answer: Yes, the Public Service Commission, West Bengal has scheduled an Edit Window starting from 28-10-2026, allowing registered candidates to make necessary corrections to their submitted application forms.
